candidates: IaC definition of the thumbnail output bucket referenced by OUTPUT_BUCKET
answer.explanation: Every ThumbnailerFunction invocation in the window fails at S3.put_object with NoSuchBucket ('The specified bucket does not exist'), while CrudApi, Uploader and Compression complete normally. NoSuchBucket means the bucket name resolved at runtime does not exist, which points to a wrong or missing bucket name in the live OUTPUT_BUCKET configuration. An IAM problem would surface as AccessDenied, not NoSuchBucket, so IAM is unlikely. The IaC candidate is listed because a drift between the template and the deployed bucket name would produce the same symptom. No tool results were available to confirm the live environment value, so this is inferred from the logs alone.
